name: team_planning_set_budget_line
description: Change a budget line in a scenario of a Team Planning plan, or add one. Give budget_line_id from team_planning_budget_lines to change a line the scenario holds, or leave it out to add one. Give every field as the line reads afterwards: a field left out is cleared. The change reaches the scenarios that follow, and a later change by the organisation to the same line no longer does. Give an amount, a head count or both. An amount needs a currency (ISO 4217) and a period, year or month, and is kept as entered, never converted; a line with no amount reads as no amount, never zero. Figures are decimal strings with at most two decimal places. origin is existing (a person's seat), replacement or new; approved_on applies to a new position only. role_id and level_id (from frameworks_get) are optional, as are location and cost_centre. Refused on the baseline, which holds the organisation's approved budget, in a plan that covers some units for a line whose cost centre none of its seats can draw on, and unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as the business reason for a move. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. A note on a change to a person goes when they are forgotten. Any other note, such as one on a unit, a position or a rule, stays until the plan is deleted, so keep personal details out of it.

scenario_id.description: The scenario. The baseline is refused.
